scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render TikTok3CEVideoToLive out/tiktok-3ce-video-to-live.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:draft: npm run assets && remotion render TikTok3CEVideoToLive out/tiktok-3ce-draft.mp4 --codec=h264 --scale=0.5
scripts.still: npm run assets && remotion still TikTok3CEVideoToLive out/frame.png --frame=60
scripts.render:ep01: npm run assets && remotion render Ep01-KhongThieuYTuong out/ep01-khong-thieu-y-tuong.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.cover:ccs01: remotion still Ep01-Cover-A out/cover-A.png && remotion still Ep01-Cover-B out/cover-B.png && remotion still Ep01-Cover-C out/cover-C.png
